deploy-bot: Production deploy started for service 'inference-api' in prod
- tag: v2.14.0
- commit: abc1234d
- initiated_by: Alex M.
- change-window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
- rollout: gradient (0->100%) over 15m

Alex M.: Kicking this off. Watch latency and error-rate dashboards.

Maria P.: I'll monitor logs and tracing, paging if anything >3% error.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% traffic at 02:05 UTC — no errors observed.

Jess (SRE): Noted. Starting smoke tests: `/tests/smoke --env prod`

Alex M.: smoke passed

deploy-bot: Canary reached 50% traffic at 02:10 UTC — error rate spike 2.8% (baseline 0.1%). Increased 5xx from 0.02->1.9% in lambdas.

Maria P.: seeing similar in traces, N+1 DB timeout around 120ms. Tagging spans: trace_id=abcd1234 link: https://tracing.redwood/trace/abcd1234

Jess (SRE): Suggest pausing rollout and rolling back to v2.13.7. @oncall-ci can you confirm rollback?

oncall-ci: I'm on it. Pausing via `/deploy pause prod v2.14.0`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by oncall-ci at 02:12 UTC

Alex M.: Any idea cause? We didn't touch DB pool sizing in this change.

Maria P.: Looks like new model context tokenization increased average request size => more CPU and DB concurrency. Need to pin model variant for prod until a fix.

Jess (SRE): Agreed. Rolling back now: ```/deploy rollback prod --to-tag v2.13.7 --reason "reduce request complexity"```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 02:14 UTC by Jess (SRE). Target: v2.13.7. Rolling back traffic to 100% over 5m.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 02:18 UTC. All services at v2.13.7. Health checks OK.

Alex M.: Confirming latency back to baseline and errors cleared. :thumbsup:

Maria P.: I'll open a follow-up ticket to pin model variant and add a perf test for tokenization blowup. JIRA RED-4521

Alex M.: Add note to release notes: "Reverted v2.14.0 due to increased DB timeouts caused by larger request contexts. v2.14.0 will be held until model/pooling fixes are applied."

Jess (SRE): Also schedule a mini-change window tomorrow 03:00-03:30 UTC to test staging with larger tokens.

deploy-bot: Production deploy summary:
- started: 1719004500
- attempted: v2.14.0
- rollback: v2.13.7
- completed: 1719004680
- initiated_by: Alex M.
- actions: paused, rollback

Oliver K.: Thanks team. I'll coordinate the postmortem and note owners.

Alex M.: Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread pinned for follow-up. :memo:
